issue_request: FHIR-6023 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It asked to make ProcedureRequest.subject optional like DiagnosticOrder.subject, but the final disposition said DiagnosticOrder had become 1..1 and therefore consistency did not require ProcedureRequest.subject to become optional; instead, the accepted change was to include Group as an allowed subject target.
initial_application: No commit mentions the full FHIR-6023 key, but historical commit 27f73740e4 includes #6023 and changes ProcedureRequest.subject from Reference(Patient) to Reference(Patient|Group) while keeping cardinality 1..1. Follow-up commit 7524d34ddd aligns the derived sheet text with the same Patient|Group and definition wording.
additional_context: ProcedureRequest is no longer active in the current build; source/fhir.ini records it as merged into ServiceRequest while ServiceRequest remains active. Current ServiceRequest.subject is 1..1 and allows Patient, Group, Location, and Device, with definition text covering groups of humans or animals. FHIR-50610 is a later ServiceRequest scope reconciliation already represented on the combined branch and explains the broader current subject/scope context without changing the FHIR-6023 conclusion.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The active conformance source already satisfies FHIR-6023 by preserving mandatory subject cardinality and including Group among ServiceRequest.subject target profiles.
